name: @w6w-apps/jobtread
description: Manage organizations, accounts, jobs, locations, and billing documents in JobTread via its Pave query API.

w6w.longDescription:
JobTread is construction project management software: jobs, customers/vendors, locations, and the estimate/order/invoice documents that move money on a job. This app covers the operational core a workflow needs — reading the connected user and the organizations they belong to, listing and creating customer/vendor accounts, listing and creating job sites (locations), listing and creating jobs, and reading billing documents (bids, orders, bills, invoices) with their status and amounts.

JobTread's API is a single endpoint (`POST https://api.jobtread.com/pave`) speaking Pave, a JSON query-by-example language in the spirit of GraphQL but with its own grammar for field selection, filtering (`where`), sorting, and pagination — and a credential that travels inside the JSON request body rather than as a header. Every action and query shape in this app was verified live against the API's own structured validation errors, or against the field-level documentation reproduced in a third-party open-source connector, never invented — see the README for what that means for the (deliberately narrower) action set here.
